name: rebuilt-dashboard
title: Rebuilt Dashboard
description: Custom-built dashboard surfaces for operations, analytics, and execution workflows inside application interfaces.
useWhen: You need a coherent dashboard example built from saved application components rather than one-off page markup.
A product surface needs a shell, summary metrics, workflow visibility, and execution detail on one screen.
A dashboard needs meaningful in-app navigation where each workspace view shows distinct operational content.
avoidWhen: The interface is primarily a marketing page or landing page.
You need a highly interactive application with domain logic, drag-and-drop, or live data behavior.
responsiveBehavior: Sections collapse from multi-column desktop layouts to stacked mobile layouts while preserving sidebar, hierarchy, and readable table overflow.
accessibility: Use navigation and landmark structure so the shell remains traversable by assistive technology.
Do not rely on color alone for status and priority information.
Tables preserve native semantics and summary cards keep visible labels.

variants.title: Ops dashboard workspace
variants.description: An interactive operations workspace with meaningful left-rail navigation that switches between overview, network, capacity, exceptions, and incident-room views.
accessibility: Use button-based navigation with visible active state and preserve descriptive headings for each workspace view.

variants.title: Ops dashboard shell
variants.description: A dashboard shell with a left navigation rail, top utility bar, and page-level summary header for a compact operations workspace.
accessibility: Keep the sidebar in a nav landmark and preserve a visible current-page indication.

variants.title: Ops dashboard KPI row
variants.description: A compact four-card KPI row with readable trend context and restrained emphasis for fast scanning.
accessibility: Metric labels and deltas stay explicit so card color is supplementary rather than required.

variants.title: Ops dashboard insights
variants.description: A chart-focused dashboard section pairing a bar-style throughput comparison with a donut-style exception breakdown and explicit legends.
accessibility: Chart colors are always paired with labels, values, and supporting explanatory text.

variants.title: Ops dashboard workflow section
variants.description: A two-column workflow section combining pipeline visibility and bottleneck status for an operations dashboard.
accessibility: Keep section headings visible and pair progress visuals with text labels and values.

variants.title: Ops dashboard execution section
variants.description: A lower dashboard section pairing a readable task table with a compact incident and handoff panel.
accessibility: Preserve native table semantics and make alert severity readable without color dependence.
